_doc: Ground truth for the HARD4 corpus (evaluation/fixtures_hard4): 10 vulnerable + 10 safe-twin fixtures spanning new axes beyond hard3 - sanitizer-in-the-middle, 4-file chain depth, type-coercion / conditional-branch / loop guards, bypassable (substring) allowlists, and cross-file second-order flow. Each safe twin keeps a dangerous-looking builder/sink but is neutralized by a guard elsewhere on the chain. [] = any finding is a false positive.

vulnerable/cmdi_mid_concat.note: raw concat in middle builder -> os.popen

vulnerable/pathtrav_mid_raw.note: user path joined raw in middle builder -> open

vulnerable/ssti_fstring_xfile.note: user text concatenated into template source -> render_template_string

vulnerable/sqli_concat_id.note: string id concatenated into SQL, no coercion

vulnerable/ssrf_branch_gap.note: host allowlist guards only the mode=checked branch; default path unguarded

vulnerable/cmdi_loop_shell.note: user args concatenated in a loop -> subprocess shell=True

vulnerable/sqli_second_order_xfile.note: cross-file second-order: safe bound write, unsafe concat on read-back (taint blind spot)

vulnerable/pathtrav_decode_xfile.note: '..' checked on encoded value; reader unquote()s after -> open

safe/cmdi_mid_shlex.note: middle builder shlex.quote()s the user value

safe/pathtrav_mid_basename.note: middle builder basename()s + anchors under fixed dir

safe/ssti_context_xfile.note: user passed as bound autoescaped context var into a fixed template

safe/deser_4file_json.note: same 4-file chain but json.loads (inert data only)

safe/sqli_int_coerce.note: id coerced to int() upstream; str(int) cannot inject

safe/ssrf_branch_all.note: host allowlist enforced unconditionally on every path

safe/cmdi_loop_validated.note: each file regex-validated in the loop + argv shell=False

safe/sqli_second_order_param.note: same store/read-back shape but read-back value is a bound parameter

safe/ssrf_allowlist_exact.note: exact parsed-hostname allowlist, not a substring test

safe/pathtrav_decode_xfile_safe.note: decode + basename upstream, before the reader
